test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some daisies are lilies.

All roses are lilies.

Some tulips are daisies.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some lilies are tulips.

(II) Some roses are daisies.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1f270006fb1b6618f856d0ed596df60170d692fe9177c20b5f1daa726452e74.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lilies are tulips → Does not follow (As some daisies are lilies and some tulips are daisies. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some roses are daisies → Does not follow (As some daisies are lilies and all roses are lilies. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**".
